summary.name: BorgBase
summary.one_liner: BorgBase is a hosted storage service for Borg and Restic backup repositories, with a web interface, API, and copy-paste setup commands.
keywords: backup to eu or us storage
use_cases: Hosting offsite Borg backups for a laptop or workstation
Storing Restic repositories in the cloud
Monitoring backup freshness and getting alerts when backups fail
Protecting existing backup archives with append-only mode
Choosing EU or US backup storage location for GDPR needs
Backing up a company NAS or larger servers
summary.what_it_does: BorgBase hosts Borg and Restic backup repositories so users can send encrypted backups to a remote service. Repositories can be managed through a web interface or API, with views of usage, quotas and security settings. The service can send alerts by email, Pushover or webhook when backups become stale or fail. It provides copy-paste commands and templates for Borg, Borgmatic and Vorta. Backups are encrypted, and append-only mode and two-factor authentication are offered to protect existing archives.
notable: Free tier with 10 GB and 2 repositories, with no API or data transfer charges
Choice of EU or United States backup location
Append-only mode and 2FA to protect existing backups
Supports Borg and Restic with guided setup commands
caveats: Paid plans start at $30/year for the Small tier; Large is $210/year or $20/month
Prices are in USD and exclude VAT, which is added for European customers at checkout
Annual plans have a 30-day refund; larger custom plans are available on request
